name: f1-review-risk-v1
target_failure: Early exits in real-game Claude-worker runs: dismissal for capability after repeated weak half-year reviews (run feedback says the review fell short and the next must be better), and trust crisis after repeated major blow-ups (accumulated hidden risk).
modules_changed: Energy step on legacy-risk warnings (moved into RISK)
alternative_diagnoses: Weak reviews come from low Skill or Network rather than Output, so an Output-led REVIEW mode will not lift the grade.
Blow-ups are driven by story choices made long before the warning, so Defuse after the warning is too late and only the story filter matters.
Actor execution failure (the worker ignores feedback it already has) rather than missing policy content; then the mode text will not change behaviour.
hypothesis: F1's balance rules react too weakly to the two observed early-exit routes. Two interruptible emergency modes driven only by the run's own feedback (REVIEW after a C/D grade or below-expectations feedback: Output-producing main action and spare Energy until a B or better; RISK after any risk warning or blow-up: Defuse legacy risk in every Energy phase and no shortcut, hide, delay or shift story options until a whole quarter passes without a new warning) reduce capability-dismissal and trust-crisis exits and raise completion and mean quantitative_score over F1, without making play permanently defensive.
change: F1 plus a Modes section (BALANCE, REVIEW, RISK) with explicit entry, action, exit and return-to-normal for each emergency; notes start with the mode and its evidence. F1's post-C/D Output line and its legacy-risk Defuse step are folded into REVIEW and RISK (REVIEW now has an exit condition and names the Output main actions; RISK makes Defuse repeat every Energy phase while warnings continue, instead of once, and turns 'avoid postponing' into a hard filter on story options). 'Output after a C or D' removed from Act. Remaining F1 text condensed with the same rules (Act/Watch/Fine, story rules, Energy order, main-action rule, late-run caution) to keep the bundle near 450 words; dropped: 'repeat a main action only while the gap persists' and the explicit pointer to energy_cost/status_updates.
predicted_behaviour: Notes begin with BALANCE, REVIEW, RISK or REVIEW+RISK plus a cited reason. After a C or D: the following quarters' main actions are Report results to your manager, Showcase results or Apply for a key project, with Prepare report materials in Energy, until a B or better appears; fewer consecutive weak grades than F1, and no capability dismissals in runs where the first weak grade arrives with time to recover. After a risk warning or blow-up: Defuse legacy risk in every following Energy phase (short warning-to-defuse lag, repeated rather than single), story notes citing disclose/fix/close, fewer second blow-ups and trust-crisis exits than F1. Modes exit: RISK ends after a quarter without warnings and REVIEW after a B or better, so the share of quarters spent in an emergency stays well below half in completed runs. Slightly lower Skill growth than F1 during emergencies.
refutation: Refuted if, on paired runs against F1 (and P0), completion rate and mean quantitative_score do not improve, or capability-dismissal and trust-crisis exits are not reduced. Manipulation fails if notes do not carry the mode label, if Output main actions do not follow C/D grades, or if Defuse does not follow risk warnings within the next Energy phase; then the text is not being executed (actor issue, see alternative_diagnoses). Over-defence is refuted as harmless if RISK or REVIEW stays active for most of a completed run with lower Level than F1 (missing or ignored exit conditions).
notes: Child of F1 for block 2 from the early Claude-worker diagnostics in findings.md (Early Claude-worker diagnostics, n tiny). No numbers, counts or calendar triggers: 'repeated weak reviews can end the run' and 'accumulated risk can end the run' restate the published failure directions qualitatively; grades S-D are published. Mode entry and exit use only grades, warning wording and the published quarterly cadence. Skill name kept as steady-balance so F1 vs child differs only in content. Compliance lint (with 116 known run titles): 0 errors, 0 review findings. 451 words of Skill text vs 486 for F1. P02 fold-in check satisfied: each note starts with the mode label and its evidence, and each mode states entry, exit and return. Note: tests/test_compliance.py::test_created_policy_metadata_and_size expects exactly 10 seed policies with change 'initial family seed' and empty parents, so it will fail until the test is updated to allow children; parents is a list of names as instructed, while careerlab register expects registered policy ids.
